item.text: The persistence code writes synchronously to the configured SQLite file, so the failure points more toward process shutdown leaving the old listener alive than data being stored only in memory. The current SIGTERM handler waits for `server.close()` before closing SQLite, but it does not force lingering HTTP keep-alive connections closed; I’m checking that lifecycle and will make shutdown deterministic.
